summary: This SEC Form 6-K by Alterity Therapeutics Ltd is a routine filing of an initial director's interest notice (Appendix 3X) pursuant to Australian law. It reports the appointment of Ann Cunningham as director on 17 April 2026 and discloses she has no relevant interests in the company's securities. There are no terms, prices, premiums, or strategic events associated with this filing. It is a standard notification of a new board appointment with no impact on control or capital structure. No special-situation event such as M&A, activism, or restructuring is involved. The filing is procedural and not a special situation.
